issue.title: just check fails at lint (mypy): tools/sase_core_wheel_cache _identity_lock and acquired_lock typing (2 errors)
issue.description:
`just check` (sase tool run check) fails at `lint (mypy)` on a tree whose diff does not touch `tools/`. The first mypy command (`mypy` over `src`) passes ("no issues found in 4966 source files"); the second (`tools/typecheck_extensionless_tools --mypy .venv/bin/mypy`) reports two errors in one file:

```
tools/sase_core_wheel_cache:433: error: Argument 1 to "contextmanager" has incompatible type "def _identity_lock(cache_root: Path, identity: CacheIdentity, *, timeout_seconds: float) -> object"; expected "def (cache_root: Path, identity: CacheIdentity, *, timeout_seconds: float) -> Iterator[Never]"  [arg-type]
tools/sase_core_wheel_cache:604: error: Need type annotation for "acquired_lock"  [var-annotated]
```

Likely root cause: `_identity_lock` is annotated `-> object` but is wrapped with `@contextmanager`, which needs an `Iterator`/`Generator` return annotation; the missing annotation on `acquired_lock` at line 604 follows from it. `tools/sase_core_wheel_cache` was last touched by adebe400d ("cache xprompt lsp build artifacts").

Impact: mypy is the first lint gate that `just check` runs after ruff, so this masks every later gate (test waits, symvision, SASE validation, and the scoped test lane) for every agent until it is fixed. Found while verifying an unrelated plan-approval tale at master 4858f20a2. Rerun with `sase tool run check` or directly: `.venv/bin/python tools/typecheck_extensionless_tools --mypy .venv/bin/mypy`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static type errors in a file no local change touches: mypy reports the same two errors on every run of tools/typecheck_extensionless_tools, and the src mypy pass is clean.
